note: Relative frames count from each backend's gate (original 1,384 / native 1,385). Samples are taken at different points in the frame (original after its frame, native before VBlank), so a mid-update sample on the original at frame n+1 is the same update as native frame n.

round1-full.coverage_in_matched_window: Round 1 wave 0 to just before wave 2: Garcia-family ($21/$23), Signal ($24) and Haku-Ro ($25) enemies, police special ($05/$0E), phone booth ($11), a player death and respawn
